about.region: MassDOT Highway District 3 (central MA), EPSG:26986 boxes 20x20 km, x0,y0,x1,y1 multiples of 1000
about.built_by: proto/obs_catalog.py (discover + fetch via .github/workflows/obs_catalog.yml) and ranking of docs/proto/obs/catalog/*.csv
about.counts: lsr_flood / stormevents_flood = raw FLOOD+FLASH FLOOD LSRs and Flood+Flash Flood Storm Events rows inside the box within 18 h of the busiest hour; reports_dedup merges LSR corrections and Storm Events rows restating an LSR (same town, within 3 min); road_sites_named = distinct (town, road) names in the road-related reports
about.times: t0 = first report - 7 h (rounded to the hour), hours so the run ends >= 5 h after the last report; all UTC. Gauge peak times are local (EDT).
